sum: Cemtrex, Inc. operates as a diversified industrial and technology company. It operates through Security and Industrial Services segments. The company offers browser-based video monitoring and analytics-based recognition systems, cameras, servers, and access control systems for security and surveillance in industrial and commercial facilities, federal prisons, hospitals, universities, schools, and federal and state government offices; and provides critical security and video surveillance solutions utilizing artificial intelligence-based data algorithms. It also provides services for rigging, millwrighting, process piping, electrical, custom fabrication, transportation and warehousing, and project management services for complex manufacturing and infrastructure projects. In addition, the company offers mission critical engineering and avionics for aerospace and defense programs. It serves industrial services, security technology, and aerospace and defense markets in the United States and internationally. The company was formerly known as Diversified American Holding, Inc. and changed its name to Cemtrex, Inc. in December 2004. Cemtrex, Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Hauppauge, New York.
ceo: Mr. Saagar  Govil (Chairman, President, CEO, Executive Officer & Secretary)
